newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Sales of 37,100 MT were mainly the result of increases for Saudi Arabia (15,000 MT), Canada (6,800 MT), and Colombia (5,200 MT).
Sales of 52,600 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for unknown destinations (50,000 MT).
Exports of 86,500 MT were three times the previous week and 59 percent more than the 4-week average.
Australia (29,200 MT), Algeria (15,800 MT), Venezuela (10,900 MT), Ecuador (10,500 MT), Colombia (10,200 MT), and Canada (9,900 MT) were the recipients.
